questions.question: If 3x − 8 = 7, what is the value of 3x + 8 ?

y = −17x + 26
y = −23x + 32
What is the solution (x, y) to the given system of equations?
questions.explanation: Setting the expressions equal: −17x + 26 = −23x + 32, so 6x = 6 and x = 1. Then y = −17 + 26 = 9.

questions.question: The function g is defined by g(x) = −18 − 9x. For what value of x does g(x) = −216?

5(8x) + 4(6y) = 12
−5(8x) + 4(6y) = 12
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 8x + 6y?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 8(6y) = 24, so 6y = 3. Subtracting gives 10(8x) = 0, so 8x = 0. Then 8x + 6y = 3.

questions.question: Line h is defined by 12x + 19y − 54 = 0. Line j is perpendicular to line h in the xy−plane. What is the slope of line j?
questions.explanation: Solving for y gives y = −(9/2)x + 486, so line h has slope −9/2. A perpendicular line has slope equal to the negative reciprocal, 2/9.

questions.question: Alex engages in up to 3 types of exercise each week for a total of 9 hours while training for a triathlon. Alex swims for the same number of <u>minutes</u> each week. The equation y = 540 − x − 200 represents the situation where Alex bikes for x minutes during a week and runs for any remaining training time y, in minutes. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane, which statement is the best interpretation of the x-intercept of the graph?
options: During a week when Alex swims for 340 minutes, he bikes for 200 minutes.
Each week, Alex bikes and runs for a total of 340 minutes.
During a week when Alex doesn’t bike, he runs for 340 minutes.
During a week when Alex doesn’t run, he bikes for 340 minutes.
questions.explanation: At the x-intercept y = 0 (no running), and then x = 340 minutes of biking.

questions.question:
a(4 − x) = 28 − 7x
In the given equation, a is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. Which of the following CANNOT be the value of a?
questions.explanation: Rearranged, (7 − a)x = 28 − 4a. If a = 7 the equation becomes 0 = 0, which has infinitely many solutions, so a cannot be 7.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 14(x<sup>2</sup> − 100y<sup>2</sup>)?
questions.explanation: x^2 − 100y^2 is a difference of squares: (x − 10y)(x + 10y).

questions.question: If (x + 2)2 = 18, what is the value of x2 + 4x?
questions.explanation: Expanding gives x^2 + 4x + 4 = 18, so x^2 + 4x = 14.

questions.question: If ( 12x −332 )2 − 64 = 0, what is the value of (x − 33)2?
questions.topic: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables

questions.question: In the xy−plane, the graph of the equation y = −x2 + 7x − 104 intersects the line y = c at exactly one point. What is the value of c?
questions.explanation: The line touches the parabola only at its vertex. At x = 7/2, y = −49/4 + 49/2 − 104 = −367/4.

questions.question:
8x2 + 13x = 6
What is the positive solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as 8x^2 + 13x − 6 = 0, which factors as (8x − 3)(x + 2) = 0. The positive solution is x = 3/8.

questions.question: The expression 19x5 + 20x5 − 10x5 is equivalent to bx5, where b is a constant. What is the value of b?
questions.explanation: Combine like terms: 19 + 20 − 10 = 29.

questions.question: For these three counties, which of the following is closest to the number of residents who voted per square mile?
questions.topic: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units

questions.question: The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. For how many of the 9 data points is the actual y-value less than the y-value predicted by the line of best fit?
questions.explanation: The points below the line are those near x = 1.5, x = 3, x = 5.4 and x = 6.3, so there are 4.

questions.question: Levi and Marissa each have stamp collections. The number of stamps in Levi’s collection is 200% of the number of stamps in Marissa’s collection. If there are 196 stamps in Marissa’s collection, how many stamps are in Levi’s collection?

A list of 10 data values is shown.

10, 14, 22, 6, 24, 26, 14, 8, 8, 8

What is the mean of these data?
questions.explanation: The sum is 140, and 140 / 10 = 14.

questions.question: A data set of 15 different values is symmetric about its median. A new data set is made by adding 5 to every value greater than the median and subtracting 5 from every value less than the median; the median value itself is unchanged. Compared with the original data set, which of the following is true about the new data set?
options: Only the standard deviation is different.
The mean and the standard deviation are both different.

questions.question: An object’s speed is increasing at a rate of 12.1 meters per second squared. What is this rate, in <u>miles per minute squared</u>, rounded to the nearest tenth? (Use 1 mile = 1,609 meters.)

A right rectangular prism has a base area of 28p square centimeters (cm<sup>2</sup>). The length of the base of the rectangular prism is 12 cm, and the height of the rectangular prism is 4 cm. Which expression represents the surface area, in cm<sup>2</sup>, of the right rectangular prism?
questions.explanation: The base width is 28p/12 = 7p/3. The surface area is 2(28p) + 4(2(12 + 7p/3)) = 56p + 96 + 56p/3 = (224p)/(3) + 96.

questions.question: An equilateral triangle is inscribed in a circle with a radius of 8 inches. What is the area of the region that lies within the circle but outside the triangle, in square inches?

A rectangular region of land is divided into 40 square lots of equal area R, in square units. The length of the region is 1.6 times the width of the region. If the width of the region is x√R units, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The area is 40R = 1.6(x√R)^2 = 1.6x^2 R, so x^2 = 25 and x = 5.

questions.question:
f(x) = |71 − 2x|
The function f is defined by the given equation. For which of the following values of k does f(k) = 3k?
questions.explanation: |71 − 2k| = 3k requires k ≥ 0. Then 71 − 2k = 3k gives k = 71/5; the other case gives k = −71, which is rejected.

questions.question:
x + 2y = 28
2y = 15
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Substitute 2y = 15 into the first equation: x + 15 = 28, so x = 13.

questions.question: What is the greatest value of x that satisfies the inequality x3 − 2 ≤ 4?
questions.topic: Linear inequalities in one or two variables

questions.question: y > 17 and 4x + y < 21. The point (x, 54) is a solution to the given system of inequalities in the xy-plane. Which of the following could be the value of x?
questions.explanation: With y = 54, 4x + 54 < 21 gives x < −8.25, so only −9 works.

questions.question: The graph shows the estimated concentration of a certain strain of bacteria, in millions of cells per mL of nutrient medium, over time x, in minutes since the initial measurement. According to the graph, which of the following is closest to the number of minutes it took for the estimated concentration of the bacteria to increase from 20 million cells per mL of nutrient medium to 30 million cells per mL of nutrient medium?
questions.explanation: The curve reaches 20 at about x = 34 minutes and 30 at about x = 50 minutes, a difference of about 16, which is closest to 15.

questions.question:
1cx = x76 + 1c
In the given equation, c is a constant. If the equation has exactly one solution, what is the value of c?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by 76cx: 76 = cx^2 + 76x, so cx^2 + 76x − 76 = 0. One solution requires discriminant 76^2 + 4(76)c = 0, so c = −19.

questions.question: The function h is defined by h(x) = (x + p)(x − 2)(2x − 12), where p is a constant. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = h(x) passes through the point (−3, 0). What is the value of h(0)?
questions.explanation: h(−3) = 0 and the other factors aren't 0 at x = −3, so −3 + p = 0 and p = 3. h(0) = (3)(−2)(−12) = 72.

questions.question:
x2 + 49x + 1 = 0
What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0 the quadratic formula is x = (−b ± √(b^2 − 4ac))/(2a). Here a = 1, b = 49, c = 1, which matches choice A.

questions.question:
The graph of the equation y = 2x + k is shown, where k is a constant.
What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: The y-intercept is (0, −6), and at x = 0, y = 1 + k, so k = −7.

questions.question:
x2 + y2 = 3,185
y − 8x = 0
A solution to the given system of equations is (x, y), where x < 0. What is the value of y?
questions.explanation: Substituting y = 8x gives 65x^2 = 3,185, so x^2 = 49 and x = −7. Then y = 8(−7) = −56.

questions.question:
f(x) = −16x2 + 85
The function f gives the estimated height, in feet, of an acorn x seconds after the acorn fell from a tree. Based on the function, what is the estimated height, in feet, of the acorn before it fell from the tree?
questions.explanation: Before the acorn fell, x = 0, so f(0) = −16(0)^2 + 85 = 85 feet.

questions.question:
The function p is defined by

p(x) = a((x + 5)2 − b)((x + 5)2 − c)

where a, b, and c are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = p(x) passes through the points (−4, 34) and (0, 150). What is the value of p(−10) + p(−4)?

h(t) = −16t2 + b
The function h estimates an object's height, in feet, above the ground t seconds after the object is dropped, where b is a constant. The function estimates that the object is 23.04 feet above the ground when it is dropped at t = 0. How many seconds after being dropped does the function estimate the object will hit the ground?

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following is closest to the slope of the line of best fit shown?
questions.explanation: The line starts near 11.5 and falls about 5.5 over 8 units, so the slope is about −0.69.

questions.question: The cost to rent a bus from Company X is $850 for the first 2 hours and an additional $30 per hour for each hour after the first 2 hours. If the total cost to rent the bus from Company X for t hours, where t > 2, is $1,030, which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: $850 covers the first 2 hours, then $30 is charged for each of the t − 2 remaining hours.

questions.question: A beaker containing a liquid is placed on a table. The function g(t) = 295 + (364 − 295)(2.72)(−0.104t) gives the approximate temperature, in kelvins, of the liquid t minutes after the beaker was placed on the table. According to this function, what was the approximate temperature, in kelvins, of the liquid when the beaker was placed on the table?

A local fitness club charges a monthly membership fee plus a flat rate for each personal training session attended. The total monthly cost c, in dollars, for a member who attends s training sessions is given by the linear equation c = 15s + 45. What is the total monthly cost, in dollars, for a member who attends 4 training sessions?

Points A, O, and C are collinear, and B is a point not on line AC, so that angle AOB and angle BOC form a linear pair. Ray OP bisects angle AOB, and ray OQ bisects angle BOC. What is the measure of angle POQ?

Rectangles ABCD and EFGH are similar. The length of each side of EFGH is 6 times the length of the corresponding side of ABCD. The area of ABCD is 96 square units. What is the area, in square units, of EFGH?
questions.explanation: Areas scale by 6^2 = 36, so the area is 96(36) = 3,456.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, angle B is a right angle. The length of side AB is 10√69 and the length of side BC is 24√69. What is the length of side AC?
In triangle JKL, cos(K) = 3660 and angle J is a right angle. What is the value of cos(L)?
questions.explanation: cos(K) = 3/5, so the sides are 3-4-5 and the side opposite K is 4/5 of the hypotenuse. Since J is the right angle, cos(L) = sin(K) = 4/5.

questions.question: In the given figure, NP is the diameter of semicircle O. Angles Q, R, and S are right angles, and point P is the midpoint of NQ. If PQ = 52 feet and NS = 18 feet, the area of the figure can be expressed as aπ + b square feet, where a and b are integers. What is the value of a − b?
questions.explanation: NP = 52, so the semicircle has radius 26 and area (1/2)π(26)^2 = 338π. The rectangle is 104 × 18 = 1872. So a = 338, b = 1872, and a − b = −1534.
